# Coley Cooks

> > Coley Cooks is a cooking and recipe website focusing on accessible culinary content and web accessibility standards.

The site provides cooking resources while maintaining strong commitments to web accessibility, implementing WCAG 2.0 compliance standards to ensure content is available to all users regardless of ability.

## Key Topics

- Recipe development
- Cooking techniques
- Web accessibility
- WCAG 2.0 compliance
- Disability access
- Accessible web design
- HTML accessibility
- CSS accessibility
- JavaScript accessibility
- Inclusive cooking content

## Optional

- [Accessibility Statement](https://coleycooks.com/accessibility-statement): WCAG 2.0 compliance statement for ColeyCooks.com accessibility features
